recipes.name: Apple Jicama Coleslaw
ingredients_raw: 0.5 small head green cabbage, cored and thinly sliced
1 large sweet apple (such as Fuji), sliced into matchsticks
0.5 teaspoon hot sauce, or to taste
salt and freshly ground black pepper to taste
0.33333334326744 ounce toasted corn bits (such as CornNuts ®), crushed

steps.text: Combine cabbage, jicama, and apple in a large bowl; set aside.
Whisk together mayonnaise, pineapple juice, sugar, hot sauce, salt, and pepper in a medium bowl until smooth and fluffy, 1 to 2 minutes.
Pour mayonnaise mixture over cabbage mixture; toss to combine. Let sit for 5 minutes.
Mix in cilantro and toss again. Garnish with corn bits to serve.

raw_recipe.headline: Apple Jicama Coleslaw
raw_recipe.description: This jicama slaw recipe is made with refreshing apples combined with a sweet-hot dressing for a coleslaw that is always a hit!

video.description: See how to make a fresh, wonderfully crispy, crunchy coleslaw.

review.reviewBody: This is delicious! Very refreshing, loved the crisp element from the apple and jicama! This is a keeper at our house.

One of the best slaws ever. Made it twice now. Recommend dipping jullienned apples in lemon sugar water to prevent browning. Easily allows a day ahead of prep. Can make dressing ahead too just wait to add until one hour before serving as suggested. Second time I added a little bit more mayo since the pineapple really thins the dressing and it needs a bit more heft to adhere. Total love.

This is a very tasty slaw ( I don't like sweet slaw, as a rule), for a nice change-up from my standard slaw. I didn't have pineapple juice on hand so used a combination of lemon and lime juices. I didn't have cilantro or corn nuts so those were omitted. Please note that this can become a spicy dressing very quickly, so add hot sauce accordingly. I may even add some dried cranberries to the mix for a little extra tang.

I also kept out a small amount of slaw mixture and dressed it with Litehouse Pear Gorgonzola Vinaigrette -- yummy!

I took this to a BBQ with friends and everyone loved it. Even the people who do not eat Coleslaw loved it. I substituted sliced Almonds for Corn nuts. I also used half mayonnaise and half greek yogurt. I will make it again for sure.
I loved this recipe with fish tacos! I did add 2 Tablespoons of chopped green pickled jalapeno peppers and diced pineapple. I omitted the corn nuts!

This was delicious! I used a bag of pre-chopped cabbage mix and Fuji apples and had to substitute agave syrup for the sweet element because I didn't have any on hand. It was perfect on the fish tacos I was making it for. The recipe makes a lot but my husband has been putting it on everything! I'll definitely be making it again!

A refreshing take on coleslaw. I made this for friends, and everyone loved it. Don't skip the Jicama or skimp on the apple; they make the coleslaw interesting and tasty. I added a teaspoon of hot sauce and wish I added one more; other than this, I followed the recipe.

This is my first time using Jicama. I was very pleased with the flavor of this recipe. I diced my cabbage and cut the matchsticks into bite-sized lengths. This will definitely be on my recipe repertoire from now on. I love it!

Wow! Amazing taste and flavor, totally a keeper! I added 1 tsp. of sriracha and thank God I listened to my husband for not adding more otherwise it would've been too hot for us. Also I didn't have any cabbage and felt lazy to go to the grocery store so used Romaine lettuce instead. It was actually pretty good but I am convinced that using cabbage (red or green) would've been a better choice. Also substituted sunflower seeds for corn nuts. Can't wait to make this again. Another fabulous recipe from Chef John...thank you!

Interesting ingredients in this coleslaw but as with several other reviewers I, too, found the dressing bland. Also thought it made 6-8 servings, not 4. My small cabbage and jicama must have been bigger than the ones Chef John used. Not surprisingly, I needed to increase the dressing by 1/2 also.
Chopped and combined 1 small can pineapple with mayo and din't use any sugar.
A unique twist on Cole slaw. Goes great with crab cakes or grilled hamburgers.
so delish , i forgot the corn nuts its still delish
Such a light, tasty salad to enjoy alone or with protein.
Bad for a potluck retirement party at work. Everyone wanted the recipe

I followed the directions exactly. It was good but I tasted it before adding the corn nuts and then after, I thought it was better without the corn nuts. My husband said the corn nuts were weird and definitely not needed. I would make it again but leave out the corn nuts which I had to go to a convenience store to even find. Overall a good light salad that is easy to make.
Made it exactly as the recipe called for and it was exceptional.
Delicious I made it as is except I substituted agave nectar for the honey just because it’s what I had on hand

Pretty good. Makes a huge amount (though maybe the cabbage I used was not small enough). I used walnuts instead of corn nuts as a preference, and added about 1 tsp sriracha to the dressing. Omitted the sugar. The dressing could still be more flavourful though the hot sauce helped. Didn't have enough cilantro, and I think the proper amount would have been better. Would definitely make again and try different variations.
Yummy!
